summary: Phase 14 (Dispute Auto-Refund Threshold + PWA Icons) fully validated. Backend: 11/11 pytest cases pass in /app/backend/tests/test_phase14_auto_refund_pwa.py — covers Settings GET/PUT (default merge, number type, persistence, non-admin 403), auto-refund happy path (dispute.status=refunded, resolution starts 'Auto-refunded', admin_notes contains 'Auto-refunded (threshold=$25.00)', resolved_at set, buyer wallet credited by amount, order cancelled, buyer + seller notifications delivered), no-auto-refund when amount > threshold (status=open, no wallet mutation, no cancellation), threshold=0 disables rule, zero-amount guard (amount>0). PWA: icon-192.png (192x192), icon-512.png (512x512), favicon.png all return 200 image/png; manifest.json lists both with purpose='any maskable'. Frontend: /admin/settings shows 'Disputes automation' section (settings-disputes-section), numeric input (dispute-auto-refund-threshold-input), helper text switches from 'Auto-refund is off' at 0 to 'Disputes on orders at or under $25.00 will auto-refund the buyer.' at 25; Save persists (verified via API GET). Threshold reset to 0 after tests.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py create_dispute auto-refund block is not transactional — if credit_wallet(seller, -X) fails after credit_wallet(buyer, +X) succeeds, buyer keeps refund and seller isn't debited. Consider wrapping in a MongoDB session/transaction or at least try/except + compensating action.

credit_wallet with negative amount allows seller wallet_balance to go negative (no floor check). Fine for now (matches manual admin refund pattern) but should be tracked — sellers with no cash-in balance will end up negative.
Auto-refund fires on ANY dispute reason (including 'other') as long as amount<=threshold. If admins want to exclude 'counterfeit'/'other' from auto-refund, that flexibility isn't there.

Notification order: buyer notify runs before seller notify but both can silently swallow failures. If buyer notify raises, dispute is already 'refunded' — the buyer just won't see the notification. Log level is fine.
resolution message hardcodes 'orders under ${threshold:.2f}' but the guard is inclusive (amount <= threshold). Copy nit: say 'at or under' to match Admin UI helper text.
